translation.name: Biblica® Open Nkanda wu Moyo, Nguizani Yimona ayi Minkunga 2002
translation.englishName: Yombe: Biblica® Open Nkanda wu Moyo, Nguizani Yimona ayi Minkunga 2002 (Bible)

content.text: Yave weti yala, bika ntoto wuyangalala.
Bika bisanga biobi bidi thama bimona nkini.
Matuti ayi tombi kinkobo binzungididi.
Busonga ayi bufuana biawu
fundasio yi kundu kiandi ki kipfumu.
Mbazu yeti kuenda ku ntualꞌandi
ayi yeti zinisa batu bobo beti kunlenda ku kadika ndambu
Zitsiemo ziandi zieti kienzula nza,
ntoto weti mona ayi weti tita.
Miongo misiuta banga mafuta momo beti vinda mu bikundu va ntuala Yave,
va ntuala Yave wu ntoto wumvimba.
Diyilu dieti yamikina busonga buandi
ayi batu boso beti mona nkembo andi.
Babo bobo bambuongiminanga zimfikula beti fua tsoni ;
bobo beti kukiniemisa mu diambu di bitumba.
Lumbuongimina, beno zinzambi zioso.
Sioni weti wa ayi weti mona khini
ayi bana ba baketo ba Yuda beti yangalala
mu diambu di zinzengolo ziaku, a Yave.
Bila ngeyo Yave, widi Nzambi yizangama va ntoto wumvimba.
Ngeyo widi wuyayusu ngolo
va yilu zinzambi zioso.
Bika babo beti zola Yave, balenda mambimbi.
Bila weti keba luzingu lu banlongo bandi.
Niandi wukubakulanga mu mioko mi batu bambimbi.
Kiezila kieti totuka mu diambu di batu basonga
ayi khini mu diambu di bobo
badi lulama mu mintima.
Bika lumona khini mu Yave, beno luidi basonga
ayi luzitisa dizina diandi di nlongo.
